beats.title: THE CASE COMPETITION CHALLENGE
beats.subtitle: Unstructured Data, Tight Deadlines, High Stakes
beats.voice_text: In premier global case competitions, teams are handed 40-page briefs, messy spreadsheets, and brutal deadlines. Most teams scramble and present surface-level summaries. Winning requires an entirely different level of systematic speed and precision.

beats.title: CHAMBER 1 & 2: INTAKE & THE GRAPHIFY BRAIN
beats.subtitle: Optical Decryption & 132+ Global Case Benchmarks
beats.voice_text: Drop in any document or dataset. The machine's optical intake chamber strips layout noise, extracts balance sheets, and maps constraints. Simultaneously, the Graphify brain traverses 132 verified global case competitions to borrow proven championship patterns.

beats.title: THE 14 AUTONOMOUS AGENTS IN LOCKSTEP
beats.subtitle: Root-Cause Surgeons, Innovation Labs, and Red Teams
beats.voice_text: Behind the scenes, fourteen specialized AI agents operate in synchronized lockstep. Root-cause surgeons isolate core bottlenecks using MECE issue trees, while the innovation lab brainstorms and scores solution archetypes against the official judging rubric.

beats.title: THE QUANTITATIVE FINANCIAL REACTOR
beats.subtitle: Little's Law, TOC Bottlenecks, and 3-Scenario Proformas
beats.voice_text: Every recommendation is backed by zero-skip industrial mathematics. Little's Law proves cycle-time compression, the Theory of Constraints synchronizes capacity, and proforma financial models survive rigorous Bear, Base, and Bull sensitivity testing.

beats.title: THE OMNICHANNEL DELIVERABLE FACTORY
beats.subtitle: PDFs, 12-Slide Pitch Deck, Financial Models, Video, and Web App
beats.voice_text: In under sixty seconds, the deliverable factory outputs the complete championship suite: two vector-grade executive blueprints, a twelve-slide pitch deck, dynamic financial models, and a live interactive web simulator.

beats.title: CHAMPIONSHIP VICTORY BY DESIGN
beats.subtitle: Airtight Judge Q&A Defense & 100% Deterministic Execution
beats.voice_text: Before you take the stage, an adversarial red-team judge stress-tests every vulnerability with pre-calculated rebuttals. This is not just analysis; it is an autonomous competition-winning machine.
